Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells

Benefit: As long as you have a healing spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to touch a target creature at half or fewer total hit points and heal 3 points of damage per level of the highest-level healing spell you can cast. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting healing spells.
